facts.text: Su-an, eat your snacks from the cart and stay close. We'll have dinner with your mother in Busan.
facts.why: Seok-woo's line is not in the film as written and it is set in quote marks. It is invented, and the tone is gentler than the film's.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted note: Seok-woo, taking Su-an to see her mother in Busan for her birthday.

fix_note.text: Su-an, eat your snack and stay where I can see you. We are going to your mother in Busan, like I promised.

vibe.verdict: Strong Korean food picks and a proper train look, but the words are soft and the zombie moments are missing.
